discovery_basis.source: Post-hoc analysis of the completed exact ring-1 screen.
findings: Pending incoming/outgoing movement strength and ETA mismatch was zero across the selected ring-1 anchor pairs, arguing against hidden queued movement orders as the immediate explanation.

Among coordinates omitted from the ring-1 matcher, absolute normalized mismatch in local net transport pressure and local recruitment hazard was more associated with demonstrable failure than most other omitted coordinates.
The combined net-transport plus recruitment-hazard mismatch had a descriptive AUC of approximately 0.686 for ring-1 demonstrable failure on 24 post-hoc pairs.
discovery_basis.guard: These are outcome-informed development findings, not confirmatory evidence.

competing_hypotheses.H_spatial_cone: Residual 30-day closure failure is primarily caused by source state outside the one-hop neighborhood.
competing_hypotheses.H_local_flow: Residual 30-day closure failure is materially caused by omitted local flow/regeneration state even after executable net flux and the one-hop reservoir are matched.

candidate.name: rootedstock_execnet_ring1_localflow17v7
candidate.rationale: Retain command-reliability-weighted executable net flux while separately matching intended net movement pressure and current local regeneration hazard.

fresh_development_screen.compute_guard: Development screen is intentionally capped at two worker threads. Do not automatically scale the screen if other workloads share the machine.

decision_rule.promising: Zero demonstrably non-equivalent pairs in the six-pair development screen, or a material reduction in demonstrable failure relative to the already-observed ring-1 failure pattern without pathological match distances.
decision_rule.not_promising: Persistent transport-dominated demonstrable failures despite acceptable match distances.
decision_rule.confirmation_guard: Any promising development result requires a new independent frozen confirmation block before a closure claim.

relationship_to_ring2_contract: This is an independent competing-state development test on a distinct fresh seed block. It must not reuse the stopped ring-2 fresh block or alter the preregistered interpretation of that contract.
scientific_guard: Synthetic model-state sufficiency experiment only; no empirical claim about real insurgencies.
